questions.question: What is the primary function of a 'skip to main content' link in accessible web architecture?
options: To skip advertisements on video players
To allow keyboard and screen reader users to bypass repetitive header navigation and jump straight to the main content
questions.explanation: A skip link allows keyboard and screen reader users to bypass repetitive top-level navigation and immediately reach <main>.

questions.question: Which triad correctly represents the foundational technologies of the front-end web platform?
questions.explanation: HTML provides structure, CSS provides visual presentation, and JavaScript drives behavior and interactivity.

questions.question: When constructing a modern webpage, what should be completed and validated first before applying CSS styling?
options: The semantic HTML document structure and accessible hierarchy
questions.explanation: Building clean, accessible, semantic HTML first ensures a solid foundation before styling with CSS.

questions.question: Which attribute on <nav> informs assistive technologies whether a menu is the primary site navigation or footer navigation?
questions.explanation: Using aria-label on <nav> elements distinguishes between multiple navigation landmarks (e.g. primary vs footer navigation).

questions.question: How many total published topics are included in the complete CodeVerse HTML curriculum?
questions.explanation: The CodeVerse HTML curriculum encompasses 28 comprehensive topics spanning foundations to modern elements.
